Endpoint: initial retained-tracer rate.

Normalization: same positive paired-reference protein-input mass for all four arms, including empty controls.

Protein construct: synthetic P.

Control preparation: synthetic empty preparation.

Protocol one and protocol zero are the intended levels.

Observation P1: protein-containing response in protocol one, 12 nmol/min/mg.

Observation E1: protein-free response in protocol one, 2 nmol/min/mg.

Observation P0: protein-containing response in protocol zero, 5 nmol/min/mg.

Observation E0: protein-free response in protocol zero, 1 nmol/min/mg.

The same E1 observation is explicitly applied to protocol zero under a stipulated reference-invariance assumption.

Reported SD: 0.6 nmol/min/mg.

Reported repetitions: three technical measurements.

Reported CI: [9, 15] nmol/min/mg.

Reported confidence: 95%.

Unsupported response: 7 widgets/min.
